test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

It was found that my shoes were cleaned.

options.text: It was found that somebody had cleaned my shoes
I found that somebody had cleaned my shoes
Somebody found out that he had cleaned my shoes

solution:
**The correct answer is Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in **Passive**** **Voice. It is in Simple Past Tense. As per the given question we have to change it into Active Voice. 
 
• The structure of Simple Past Tense is as follows:
 
 
• Subject + V2 + Object. (Active Voice)
 
• Subject (objective case)+ was/were + V3 + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice)
 
 
 
• Example:
 
 
• *Their cousin showed them some rare photographs. (Active Voice)*
 
• *They were shown some rare photographs by their cousin. (Passive Voice)*
 
 
 
• In the first part of the sentence:
 
 
• In the given sentence, the doer of the action is not mentioned.
 
• We might need to add this information or rephrase the sentence in a way that implies who performed the action.
 
• 'Was found' will be changed into 'found.'
 
• 'Were cleaned' will be changed into 'cleaned.' 
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 4.

 

Correct sentence: *Someone found my shoes cleaned.*
